chatBehavior.title: Chat Behavior
chatBehavior.autoApproveToolsDesc: Let the assistant run tools without an approval prompt. Leave this off if you want to review requests before a tool runs.
chatBehavior.desktopNotificationsDesc: Notify you when a reply is ready while you are using another app.

shortcuts.newProjectDesc: Start a new project to organize related chats.

interface.title: Interface
interface.themeDesc: Choose light or dark colors, or follow your computer’s appearance setting.
interface.windowBackgroundDesc: Set the app window's background color.
interface.appMainViewDesc: Choose the background color behind your conversations.
interface.primaryDesc: Choose the color used for important controls and highlights.
interface.accentDesc: Choose the color used for secondary controls and highlights.
interface.destructiveDesc: Choose the color used for actions that remove data.
interface.resetToDefaultDesc: Reset all interface settings to default.
interface.resetInterfaceSuccessDesc: All interface settings have been restored to default.
interface.threadScrollDesc: Choose whether the conversation scrolls automatically while the assistant replies.
interface.threadScrollFlowHint: Keep your place while a reply arrives. Move to your next message when you send it.
interface.threadScrollStickyHint: Scroll to show the newest text as the assistant writes.
interface.tokenCounterCompact: Show text usage inside the message box
interface.tokenCounterCompactDesc: Show the token count inside the message box instead of below it. Tokens are the small pieces of text a model reads.
interface.codeBlockDesc: Choose the colors used to make code easier to read.
interface.showLineNumbersDesc: Display line numbers in code blocks.
interface.resetCodeBlockStyleDesc: Reset code block style to default.
interface.resetCodeBlockSuccessDesc: Code block style has been restored to default.

hardware.name: Name
hardware.enableVulkanDesc: Use Vulkan API for GPU acceleration. Do not enable Vulkan if you have an NVIDIA GPU as it may cause compatibility issues.

httpsProxy.proxyUrlDesc: Leave the proxy off unless your network requires one. Ask your network administrator for the address and port, then enter both here.
httpsProxy.authenticationDesc: Enter the username and password supplied for your proxy. Leave these empty if it does not require sign-in.
httpsProxy.noProxyDesc: These addresses bypass the proxy. Separate them with commas; keep localhost and 127.0.0.1 for services on this computer.
httpsProxy.ignoreSslDesc: Allow connections whose security certificate cannot be verified. Leave this off unless your network administrator requires it for a trusted proxy.
httpsProxy.proxySslDesc: Validate the SSL certificate when connecting to the proxy.
httpsProxy.proxyHostSslDesc: Validate the SSL certificate of the proxy's host.
httpsProxy.peerSslDesc: Validate the SSL certificates of peer connections.
httpsProxy.hostSslDesc: Validate the SSL certificates of destination hosts.

localApiServer.title: Local API Server
localApiServer.description: Let other apps use the models in GChat. Choose a default model in Model Providers, then select Start server and copy the address into the other app.
localApiServer.serverLogsDesc: View detailed logs of the local API server.
localApiServer.runOnStartupDesc: Off by default. Enable to start the Local API Server when GChat opens.
localApiServer.serverHostDesc: Choose whether only apps on this computer can connect, or other devices on your network too.
localApiServer.serverPortDesc: Keep the default unless another app uses this number. Other apps must use the same port in their connection address.
localApiServer.apiPrefixDesc: Keep /v1 for OpenAI-compatible apps unless their setup instructions require a different path.
localApiServer.apiKeyDesc: Set a secret key, then enter the same key in each app that connects to this server.
localApiServer.trustedHostsDesc: Enter the addresses other apps use to reach this computer, separated by commas. For example: 192.168.1.100,my-computer. Do not enter the connecting app’s address. Use * for any address; address ranges and partial wildcards are not supported.
localApiServer.autoStart: Start this server when GChat opens
localApiServer.autoStartDesc: Start the API server automatically so connected apps can use it without you starting it each time.
localApiServer.corsDesc: Allow web pages from other addresses to call this API. Enable this when connecting a browser-based app that requires it.
localApiServer.verboseLogsDesc: Record extra server activity to help investigate a problem.
localApiServer.proxyTimeoutDesc: How many seconds a connected app can wait for the model to respond before the request ends.
localApiServer.defaultModelDesc: The server loads this model when it starts.
localApiServer.defaultModelDescHint: To change it, update your default chat model in
localApiServer.defaultModelPlaceholder: Choose a default model in Model Providers

attachments.subtitle: Choose how GChat includes attached files and images in your conversations.
attachments.enableDesc: Allow GChat to read supported files that you attach to a conversation.
attachments.parseModeDesc: Choose whether GChat includes the document text in your message or asks you each time.
attachments.documentSearchUnavailableDesc: You can include document text in chat or let a chat tool read a file. Searching documents by meaning is not available in this version.
attachments.availableParseModeDesc: Include document text in chat adds the text to your message. Automatic can use a document-reading tool or include text that fits. Automatic and Ask me each time may also offer document search, which is unavailable.
attachments.savedDocumentSearchUnavailableDesc: Your saved choice requires document search. Choose Include document text in chat or another available option. Your saved choice is kept until you change it.
attachments.availableAutoInlineThresholdDesc: The maximum share of the model’s conversation limit that Automatic uses for document text. Larger documents need a document-reading tool or an explicit choice to include the text; document search is unavailable.
attachments.autoInlineThresholdDesc: The share of the model’s conversation limit that attached document text may use before another method is needed.
attachments.maxFileDesc: Files larger than this limit cannot be attached or processed.
attachments.thresholdDesc: Minimum similarity score (0-1). Only used for linear cosine search, not ANN.
attachments.searchModeDesc: Choose between sqlite-vec ANN, linear cosine, or auto.
attachments.chunkSizeDesc: Approximate max characters per chunk for embeddings.
attachments.maxImageSizeDesc: Resize larger images to this width or height before the model reads them. Smaller images use less of the model’s available space.

changeDataFolder.title: Move GChat data
changeDataFolder.description: Move your GChat data to the folder shown below. GChat will restart when the move finishes. Check that the new folder has enough free space before continuing.

backendUpdater.backgroundUpdateDesc: Downloading {{backend}} in the background. You can keep working.

backendMismatch.runtimeCpuTitle: Your model is running on the CPU

backendMismatch.runtimeCpuDesc: {{configured}} is selected, but the model was loaded on {{device}}. Generation will be much slower than your hardware allows.
backendMismatch.silentFallbackDesc: Settings show {{configured}}, but the model was started on {{effective}} because the selected backend was unavailable.
backendMismatch.suboptimalDesc: Get faster responses with a backend optimized for your hardware.
backendMismatch.cudaRuntimeHint: The selected CUDA build could not find a CUDA runtime on this machine. Installing the NVIDIA CUDA runtime, or switching to a backend that bundles it, fixes this.
backendMismatch.vulkanDriverHint: A Vulkan backend needs a working Vulkan driver. If your GPU should be supported, updating the graphics driver — or installing the Vulkan runtime on Linux — usually fixes this.
backendMismatch.rocmRuntimeHint: A ROCm backend needs the AMD ROCm runtime installed and a supported RDNA2–RDNA4 GPU. Installing ROCm, or switching to the Vulkan backend, fixes this.
backendMismatch.actuallyRunningCpuLayers: Actually running on the CPU: {{offloaded}} of {{total}} layers on the GPU
